name: TC-ENQ-007: [Negative] Create Enquiry with Missing Mobile and Assert Failure at Sanitization API
description: Enquiry creation accepts empty/missing mobile with 200, and sanitization API fails validation.
descriptionHtml: Enquiry creation accepts empty/missing mobile with 200, and sanitization API fails validation.

testStage.description: Enquiry creation accepts empty/missing mobile with 200, and sanitization API fails validation.

steps.name: Step 1: Trigger /API/enquiry/create/ with empty mobile number (expects 200)
Step 2: Trigger /auth/v1/enquiry/sanitize/v2/ with empty mobile (expects 'phone/mobile missing' validation failure)
